title: Creation
description: An modpeck thats full of create mods and train gen mods
body:
Creation SMP is a NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack focused on creativity, exploration, building, and multiplayer adventures.
  Discover improved structures and world generation, automate ambitious projects, travel with Waystones, explore using
  Xaero’s maps, and enjoy enhanced visuals with shaders and quality-of-life improvements. Build, explore, and create
  your own story with friends.
